quarterly_data.quarter: Crusoe press release: Crusoe Spark supports NVIDIA DSX POD (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Crusoe's Crusoe Spark modular AI data center platform will support the NVIDIA DSX POD reference design (a blueprint for modular infrastructure for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform). Crusoe has built and operated modular AI factories since 2020; production is powered by its in-house engineering and domestic manufacturing footprint, including the 352,000 sq ft Crusoe Spark Factory in Brighton, Colorado, with next-generation liquid units slated for 2027; in 2022 it acquired electrical manufacturing specialist Easter-Owens Electric.
quarterly_data.figure: 352,000 sq ft Crusoe Spark Factory; next-generation liquid units slated for 2027
